Mint a Sprites bearer token from a Fly.io macaroon

POST with Authorization: FlyV1 {FLY_API_TOKEN}. Sprite CRUD rejects Bearer FLY_API_TOKEN (401); callers mint once, cache, then Bearer the returned token. 401 with 'sprites not enabled' means the org has not enabled Sprites.
